_comment: User-provided valid default values for Odoo (Owl.js SPA). Starter scaffold — extend after running extract on the pages you plan to test. Field names come from Odoo's standard Contacts / Sales / Inventory modules; adjust to match your install's exact labels. Odoo's SPA occasionally re-renders with fresh element IDs between extract and execute — prefer label-based lookup here, and keep defaults for the stable human-readable labels rather than technical IDs.
_dependencies_comment: Wall 1.1 — common cascade on Odoo contact forms is State depends on Country. Populate once observed via extract. Key format: '{screen}:{label_slug}:{type}' or '{screen}:{section_slug}:{label_slug}:{type}' — match the element_id emitted by Extract.
